verdict.rationale: Fly.io ships an official CLI (flyctl) documented for install and deploy workflows, which is inherently scriptable and could be run in automation/CI, but the evidence pack contains no explicit mention of CI integration, deploy tokens, GitHub Actions, or non-interactive/headless flags. missing for 10: explicit CI/automation docs (e.g. GitHub Actions integration, FLY_API_TOKEN for non-interactive auth), independent confirmation of headless usage in pipelines.
